description: This file implements functions to compute CRC checksums for files and directories related to host tools, specifically for versioning or integrity verification within the Android Open Source Project. It includes functions to calculate CRCs for individual files, directories, and aggregates CRCs for specific directories like 'bin' and 'lib64'.

methods.name: FileCrc
methods.description: Calculates the CRC checksum of a file specified by its path.

methods.name: DirectoryCrc
methods.description: Calculates CRC checksums for all files within a directory, returning a map of filenames to CRC values.

methods.name: HostToolsCrc
methods.description: Aggregates CRCs for the 'bin' and 'lib64' directories and returns a combined map of file paths to CRC values.
